entry.title: Read the book they bring back
entry.summary: Choose a book you both enjoy and let familiar pictures open a conversation. Repeated readings can be part of the pleasure.
entry.cue: Notice the pages, subjects, or books your child returns to.
detail: Davies favors books connected to daily life and a child’s interests, with room for families, cultures, and experiences different from your own. Simple words or sentences can grow into longer stories as interest changes.
Show a slow page turn and careful return to the shelf. Keep a few covers visible in a basket or on a shelf so your child can choose.
Her emphasis on realistic books is a Montessori preference. She also describes enjoying an occasional pretend story while playfully pointing out what is pretend.
